class.peasant.quito: a member of an ayllu, a farming kin group

class.craftsman.quito: from a family of kamayuq craftsmen
class.landowner.cusco: from a curaca family, local lords
class.landowner.quito: from a curaca family, local lords
class.noble.cusco: from a royal ayllu, the "long-eared" Inca nobility
class.noble.quito: from a royal ayllu, the "long-eared" Inca nobility
class.slave.family.cusco: into a family of yanakuna, servants of a noble house
class.slave.family.quito: into a family of yanakuna, servants of a noble house

prof.chinampa_farmer.desc: Garden beds built of lake mud and reeds: three harvests a year, if the water does not rise.
prof.mita_builder.desc: Your labour duty to the state: roads, bridges, terraces and fortresses. Hard work, but you are fed from state storehouses.
prof.amanteca.desc: The amanteca make shields, cloaks and headdresses for lords and gods out of quetzal and hummingbird feathers.
prof.aclla.desc: Girls are chosen for the "houses of the chosen", where they weave the finest cumbi cloth and brew chicha for the Sun and the Inca.
prof.pochteca.desc: Long-distance merchants: caravans of porters, months on the road to the hot lands, and the eyes and ears of the ruler as well.
prof.chasqui.desc: You run from one relay station to the next with a message memorised and a khipu in hand. News crosses hundreds of miles in days.
prof.eagle_warrior.desc: You have taken four captives and joined the order of Eagles and Jaguars. Honour, a place at the palace, and danger in the front ranks.
prof.farmer.desc.AMR: Maize, beans, squash and chillies on land held by your calpulli ward.
prof.farmer.desc.cusco: Potatoes and quinoa on the slopes, maize in the valleys. The fields of the Sun and the Inca are worked first, then your own.
prof.farmer.desc.quito: Potatoes and quinoa on the slopes, maize in the valleys. The fields of the Sun and the Inca are worked first, then your own.
prof.laborer.desc.AMR: There are no carts and no pack animals here: everything goes on people's backs, with a strap across the forehead.
prof.artisan.desc.AMR: Potter, stone carver, obsidian knapper or goldsmith.
prof.artisan.desc.cusco: Potter, stonemason or goldsmith. The best are taken to work for the Inca.
prof.artisan.desc.quito: Potter, stonemason or goldsmith. The best are taken to work for the Inca.
prof.weaver.desc.AMR: Cotton quachtli cloaks are clothing, tribute and nearly money.
prof.weaver.desc.cusco: Llama and alpaca wool on a backstrap loom. In the Andes cloth is worth more than gold.
prof.weaver.desc.quito: Llama and alpaca wool on a backstrap loom. In the Andes cloth is worth more than gold.
prof.midwife.desc.AMR: You deliver babies, steam mothers in the temazcal and greet each child with words about its fate.
prof.midwife.desc.cusco: You deliver babies, heal with herbs and know which huaca to pray to.
prof.midwife.desc.quito: You deliver babies, heal with herbs and know which huaca to pray to.
prof.merchant.desc.AMR: Tlatelolco is a vast market: cacao, feathers, slaves, obsidian, maize. Market judges watch for cheats.
prof.merchant.desc.cusco: There is no money: you swap salt, chillies and wool at fairs, as far as the authorities allow.
prof.merchant.desc.quito: Northern traders carry salt, cotton and coca between the mountains and the warm valleys.
prof.sailor.desc.AMR: The lake is the main road: you ferry people, maize and stone in a dugout and catch fish and birds.
prof.soldier.desc.AMR: Every youth learns war in the telpochcalli. Glory lies in captives taken, not in men killed.
prof.soldier.desc.cusco: Communities take turns sending men to the Inca's army: slings, maces and long marches north.
prof.soldier.desc.quito: Communities take turns sending men to the Inca's army: slings, maces and long marches north.
prof.officer.desc.AMR: You lead your ward's company into battle.
prof.officer.desc.cusco: You answer for a hundred warriors, and for their families back home.
prof.officer.desc.quito: You answer for a hundred warriors, and for their families back home.
prof.scribe.desc.AMR: You paint glyphs and pictures in books of bark paper and deerskin: tribute, lawsuits, history, the calendar.
prof.scribe.desc.cusco: There is no writing, but there are khipus, knotted cords. You keep and read in them tribute, stores and people.
prof.scribe.desc.quito: There is no writing, but there are khipus, knotted cords. You keep and read in them tribute, stores and people.
prof.official.desc.AMR: You make sure conquered towns deliver tribute: cloaks, cacao, feathers, grain.
prof.official.desc.cusco: Your cords hold a whole province: people, herds, storehouses.
prof.official.desc.quito: Your cords hold a whole province: people, herds, storehouses.
prof.physician.desc.AMR: Hundreds of herbs, obsidian bloodletting, the temazcal steam bath and spells.
prof.physician.desc.cusco: Herbs, coca, setting bones. They say healers here can even open the skull.
prof.physician.desc.quito: Herbs, coca, setting bones. They say healers here can even open the skull.
prof.priest.desc.AMR: Fasts, night vigils, the calendar and songs to the gods. Priests teach noble youths in the calmecac.
prof.priest.desc.cusco: You serve the Sun, the sacred huacas and the ancestor mummies, and read fate in coca leaves.
prof.priest.desc.quito: You serve the Sun, the sacred huacas and the ancestor mummies, and read fate in coca leaves.
prof.landholder.desc.AMR: Lands earned in war, people who work them, a seat in the council.
prof.landholder.desc.cusco: Head of a community: you assign mit'a labour, judge disputes and answer to the Inca for everyone.
prof.landholder.desc.quito: Head of a community: you assign mit'a labour, judge disputes and answer to the Inca for everyone.
prof.magistrate.desc.AMR: You judge nobles and commoners by harsh laws: a judge who takes a bribe can be put to death.
prof.magistrate.desc.cusco: You govern a province in the Inca's name: roads, storehouses, justice and the census.
prof.magistrate.desc.quito: You govern a province in the Inca's name: roads, storehouses, justice and the census.
prof.matron.as.AMR: the lady of a great house
prof.matron.desc.AMR: Servants, storerooms, weaving and guests: all of it is yours to run.
prof.matron.as.cusco: the lady of a great house
prof.matron.as.quito: the lady of a great house
prof.matron.desc.cusco: Yana servants, weavers, stores of chicha and wool: all of it is yours to run.
prof.matron.desc.quito: Yana servants, weavers, stores of chicha and wool: all of it is yours to run.
prof.household_slave.desc.AMR: You serve in your master's house. Here a slave may have a family and property, and children are born free.
prof.household_slave.desc.cusco: You were taken from your ayllu and given to serve a noble house, for life.
prof.household_slave.desc.quito: You were taken from your ayllu and given to serve a noble house, for life.
prof.field_slave.desc.AMR: You work your master's fields until your debt is paid or you buy your freedom.
prof.field_slave.desc.cusco: You work the royal estates and may not return to your ayllu.
prof.field_slave.desc.quito: You work the royal estates and may not return to your ayllu.
prof.workshop_owner.desc.AMR: Your own workshop in the artisans' quarter, apprentices and commissions from the nobility.
prof.workshop_owner.desc.cusco: You head a workshop that works for the Inca.
prof.workshop_owner.desc.quito: You head a workshop that works for the Inca.
prof.overseer.desc.AMR: Your master has trusted you with the other servants and the stores.
prof.overseer.desc.cusco: Your lord has trusted you with the other servants and the herds.
prof.overseer.desc.quito: Your lord has trusted you with the other servants and the herds.
cause.mountain_road: a fall on a mountain trail
focus.learn.desc.AMR: The telpochcalli for commoners, the calmecac for nobles: chores, songs, glyphs, counting
focus.learn.desc.cusco: Khipu knots, counting, the family's traditions. Nobles study at the yachay wasi
focus.learn.desc.quito: Khipu knots, counting, the family's traditions. Nobles study at the yachay wasi
focus.study.desc.AMR: Glyphs, the calendar, songs and the speeches of elders. The teacher expects gifts
focus.study.desc.cusco: Khipus, counting, traditions. The teacher expects gifts
focus.study.desc.quito: Khipus, counting, traditions. The teacher expects gifts
focus.religion.desc.AMR: Temples, fasts, offerings, the festivals of the calendar
focus.religion.desc.cusco: Offerings to the Sun, Pachamama and the ancestor mummies
focus.religion.desc.quito: Offerings to the Sun, Pachamama and the ancestor mummies
focus.trade.desc.AMR: Risk your goods for a profit at the market
focus.trade.desc.cusco: Swap your surplus at the fairs
focus.trade.desc.quito: Swap your surplus at the fairs
lifestyle.food.varied.desc.AMR: Fish and fowl from the lake, turkey, fruit from the hot lands. Good for your health
lifestyle.food.feasts.desc.AMR: Feasts with chocolate, turkey and songs. Honourable and costly
lifestyle.food.meager.desc.AMR: Maize gruel and cakes of lake algae. Your health suffers
lifestyle.food.plain.desc.cusco: Potatoes, chuño, quinoa and chilli stew
lifestyle.food.plain.desc.quito: Potatoes, chuño, quinoa and chilli stew
lifestyle.food.varied.desc.cusco: Dried llama meat, maize, fruit from the warm valleys. Good for your health
lifestyle.food.varied.desc.quito: Dried llama meat, maize, fruit from the warm valleys. Good for your health
lifestyle.food.feasts.desc.cusco: Feasts with chicha, meat and dancing. Honourable and costly
lifestyle.food.feasts.desc.quito: Feasts with chicha, meat and dancing. Honourable and costly
lifestyle.food.meager.desc.cusco: Nothing but chuño and water. Your health suffers
lifestyle.food.meager.desc.quito: Nothing but chuño and water. Your health suffers
lifestyle.exercise.gymnasium.desc.AMR: A heavy rubber ball, hips and the walls of the court. Stronger and healthier
lifestyle.exercise.gymnasium.desc.cusco: Running mountain trails, the sling, wrestling at festivals. Stronger and healthier
lifestyle.exercise.gymnasium.desc.quito: Running mountain trails, the sling, wrestling at festivals. Stronger and healthier
lifestyle.medicine.temple.desc.AMR: Prayers, offerings and a priest's herbs
lifestyle.medicine.physician.desc.AMR: A healer looks after the family. Costly, but fewer deaths
lifestyle.medicine.temple.desc.cusco: A coca diviner and offerings to the spirits
lifestyle.medicine.temple.desc.quito: A coca diviner and offerings to the spirits
lifestyle.medicine.physician.desc.cusco: A hampikamayuq looks after the family. Costly, but fewer deaths
lifestyle.medicine.physician.desc.quito: A hampikamayuq looks after the family. Costly, but fewer deaths
lifestyle.baths.rarely.desc.AMR: The lake and a jar of water
lifestyle.baths.sometimes.desc.AMR: The steam bath on feast days
lifestyle.baths.daily.desc.AMR: A wash every day and the steam bath often. Clean and sociable. You must live in a town
lifestyle.baths.rarely.desc.cusco: An icy stream, when you have to
lifestyle.baths.rarely.desc.quito: An icy stream, when you have to
lifestyle.baths.daily.desc.cusco: Warm water every day. Clean and sociable. You must live in a town
lifestyle.baths.daily.desc.quito: Warm water every day. Clean and sociable. You must live in a town
religion.aztec_gods.texcoco: the Aztec gods and Tloque Nahuaque
religion.catholic.desc.AMR: Franciscan friars baptise thousands, raise churches where temples stood and teach prayers in a foreign tongue.
